name: matrix
status: PROVISIONAL (M8 heuristic, not yet validated by the L3 budget study)
provenance: Derived 2026-10-12 from the 2026-10-07 full-analysis matrix: replay counts in harness/budgets.json (idle machine, CleanSheet, balanced 30 s + 120 s, seed 20260922) and the refinement best-so-far penalised-cost curves in runs/<preset>/CleanSheet/pipeline/solvers/vlm/optimization_search.json. Only the refinement stage has a recorded curve; screening budgets are a flagged 40% heuristic. Presets with no feasible candidate in the source run (ATR72-600, C919) carry no curve information. Per-preset objective stability against the 30 s + 120 s result is the L3 study, not claimed here.
mode_scale_basis: Per-candidate cost measured in the 2026-10-07 matrix (candidate_time_s, loaded 16-lane host, so an upper bound): at these budgets the table costs about 9.8k core-s in fixed_requirement but about 40k core-s in each of mtow_band and payload_adjusted (3-6x per evaluation; A380 mtow_band 41 core-s per screening candidate). Scaling the two iterating modes to 0.3 brings the 36 cells to about 34k core-s, about 44 min on 15 threads at 0.85 utilization [E]. Without it the matrix is about 110 min. Replace by the L3 study or by L5 speed-ups.
